findings.summary: IC power pin U12.5 (BST) has no DC path to a power rail (net '__unnamed_2')
findings.description: Pin U12.5 (BST) is type=power_in on net '__unnamed_2'. Graph walk (≤2 hops, rejecting capacitor edges, accepting resistors≤1Ω, inductors, ferrite beads, bridged solder jumpers) did not reach a named power rail. The pin is likely AC-coupled to ground only — the IC will not power up reliably.
findings.recommendation: Verify the schematic for this pin: the DC route must go through a conducting element (direct wire, 0Ω resistor, inductor, ferrite bead, or bridged solder jumper) — not a capacitor. If the intent was to tie VCC through an LC filter, add the missing inductor or 0Ω in series.

report_context.impact: IC supply floats DC; board will not run.

findings.summary: U12 pin EN (EN) missing pull-up resistor
findings.description: Pin EN on U12 (MP2338GTL-Z) is connected to net EN but has no pull-up resistor. This pin type typically requires an external pull-up to a power rail for correct operation.
findings.recommendation: Add a 4.7k-10k pull-up resistor from EN to the appropriate power rail.

fix_params.basis: Pin EN is open-drain/input type requiring pull-up

report_context.impact: Pin may float or bus may not function without pull-up
